messages:
sarah-sales: Quick sync — ACME Bank wants the formal SOW language for BYO-KMS plus a throughput proof for 10k QPS during peak hourly bursts. They also asked for a 48h pen-test window. Can we commit timelines?
alex-se: Ack. I can produce a performance report, but we need test vectors from ENG-OPS (traffic shape + seq len). Also need to confirm HSM egress constraints for BYOK.
tariq-crypto: On egress: customer keys never leave the HSM; we only send wrapped ciphertext. Legal asked for an explicit line: "no plaintext key material exported" — we can add.
maria-legal: Yes please add that line. Also need a clause about rotation windows (acceptable outage window) and who signs key custody attestation.
ellis-eng-ops: For the throughput proof, we can run a staged load test in staging with a curated prompt set. Earliest slot: Wed 03:00–06:00 UTC. We can demonstrate sustained 10k QPS for 15 mins with autoscale headroom. Need a whitelist IP range from customer to validate HSM proxy.
sarah-sales: Customer asked for pen-test window next Friday. Is that compatible with your Wed slot? We should avoid conflicting dates. Also pricing: they want to know if BYO-HSM adds a premium or just metered egress.
alex-se: Pricing model: BYO-KMS adds a fixed ops onboarding fee + per-request routing overhead (small). I'll confirm numbers but propose: onboarding $15k one-time, + 0.5¢/request above baseline for HSM proxy routing. Need finance signoff.
tariq-crypto: For rotation, we recommend customer-controlled KEK rotation every 90 days; we can support manual rotation or an automated rotation API. We need to document rotation handshake (nonce, wrap key thumbprint, rotation cutoff).
maria-legal: Add a rollback/backout procedure to the SOW in case rotation causes regressions. Also we need a 3rd-party attestation clause for HSM (FIPS 140-2 level 3 mention?).
ellis-eng-ops: Attestation ok. For the network allowlist, ask customer to open these egress ports: 443 outbound to our proxy 34.82.10.23/32 and 34.82.10.24/32. Sample curl to validate handshake:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/healthz
```
ellis-eng-ops: We'll capture latency p95 and tokenized per-request CPU during the test. Need to decide whether test uses real customer keys or test keys wrapped by cust KEK. Prefer test keys.
sarah-sales: Customer pushes for test with their staging keys to validate end-to-end. Any compliance objection?
tariq-crypto: We can do it with their staging KEK but only if they generate the KEK in their HSM and only provide the wrapped test keys. We'll add "no unencrypted key export" and require key thumbprint verification.
maria-legal: Also include an indemnity paragraph for pen-test related downtime limited to a cap (e.g., 2x monthly SLA credit).
alex-se: I'll draft the SOW snippet and the performance checklist. Action items: 1) Sarah to confirm pen-test date with ACME, 2) Ellis to book Wed slot or propose alternate, 3) Tariq to draft KEK rotation handshake, 4) Maria to add legal clauses, 5) Alex to slot pricing numbers and perf report.
sarah-sales: Thanks — I pinged ACME and they prefer Friday window. I'll propose Fri 03:00–06:00 UTC (match our low-traffic window).
deploy-bot: scheduled: perf-test-job-1735001111 created; start=1735087511 end=1735098311 (Fri 03:00–06:00 UTC).
ellis-eng-ops: Got the deploy job. If customer confirms allowlist by EOD tomorrow we can run preflight checks and finalize the SOW wording.
maria-legal: Drafted clauses: "No plaintext key export", "Rotation rollback playbook", "Pen-test limited liability (cap=2x SLA credit)", "HSM attestation requirement: FIPS 140-2 L3 where applicable" — will drop in a doc and share.
tariq-crypto: I'll attach a short checklist for KEK handshake: wrap-alg, thumbprint method (SHA256), rotation grace period, and required audit logs.
sarah-sales: Perfect. I'll compile and send ACME the combined SOW + checklist + pricing by EOD. :thumbsup:
